positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Perform analysis, design, and development of maintainable software solutions for Symantec's advanced information integrity products. Responsibilities include maintaining currency in emerging security threats and rapidly developing creative solutions to those threats, anticipating and overcoming challenges, working closely with a team of professionals in program management and quality assurance to devise and implement solutions, contribute to development plans and schedules, and provide expert technical guidance to other members of the team.
